name: folio-web
description: The page that reads a Tisty Share link in the browser: it opens the envelope with the key in the link's #, which never reaches the server, and draws the body with tisty-editor.

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p folio-wasm --profile folio-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/folio-wasm/folio_wasm.wasm
